GetAppYAML(recommendationservice) confirms the mismatch in the pod template: containerPort 8080 and env PORT=8080, livenessProbe grpc port 8080 (passes, so the container is never restarted), but readinessProbe grpc port 8081 where nothing listens. Service mapping itself is correct (port 8080 -> targetPort 8080), yet endpoints/recommendationservice shows an empty ENDPOINTS column because the pod never becomes Ready, so frontend has no serving backend. GetErrorLogs for recommendationservice returned no error logs, and namespace-level events carry no Warning rows, locating the fault purely in the readiness probe port configuration.
